visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark background for a premium matte feel. Include an SVG noise filter component.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #212D24 for structure and bento boxes. Technical grid look where applicable.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows on hover. Soft glow effects for active elements.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal Glass variant: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10 for the header.

logo.description: Minimalist geometric SVG mark. A stylized 'C' intertwined with a minimal box shape representing logistics, and the wordmark 'CIKALA' in bold Cabinet Grotesk.
logo.instructions: Create an original inline SVG logo in the header and as a favicon replacement.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height (100vh). Kinetic text masking on load (framer-motion). Large background image with 50% black overlay. Line-by-line reveal for H1.
layouts.about: Editorial layout. Large text on the left, smaller descriptive text on the right. High contrast text. Asymmetrical.
layouts.services: Bento Grid (Mode A). 12-column grid. Asymmetrical sizing for 'Sourcing', 'Distribution', 'Supply'. Use tight borders and hover zoom effects for images inside cards.
layouts.products: Horizontal scroll or Masonry grid of high-quality product images with hover-to-reveal text details.
layouts.contact: Split layout. Left: large 'Let's Talk / Hablemos' text. Right: Shadcn form with customized dark inputs.

components.navbar: Sticky Glassmorphism header with bilingual toggle (ES/EN) and smooth scroll anchor links.
components.marquee: Editorial Marquee (Subtle/Organic) between About and Services sections. 'Premium Ingredients — Global Sourcing — Wholesale — Gastronomy'.

motion.reveal: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-up and scale-in of grid items.
motion.hero_reveal: Initial load masking line-by-line reveal for heading (staggered).

image_urls.description: Spices on shelves - use in Products section or Bento Grid.
Warehouse shelving - use in Logistics/Distribution service card.
Chef in modern kitchen - use as hero background with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/50).
Assorted vegetables - use in Products showcase.
Workers in warehouse - use for About Us section.
Fruits, seeds, spices in bowls - use for Sourcing/Supplying card.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast or text-shadow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth scrolling wrapper.
Install `framer-motion` and use it for the kinetic line-by-line reveal in the hero and scroll animations.
Implement a bilingual translation dictionary (ES/EN) and a context provider with a toggle in the navbar.
Create a functional contact form using Shadcn forms and wire it to a FastAPI backend endpoint to save to a SQLite DB.
For the Bento Grid in 'Servicios', ensure it follows the 'Tetra Grid' logic, asymmetric with empty spaces or spanned cards.
Load Cabinet Grotesk (or similar geometric bold sans like Satoshi/Clash Display) via Google Fonts or standard imports. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Create a React component for a noise overlay (`pointer-events-none`) to apply globally for texture.
Implement the 'Inicio, Nosotros, Servicios, Productos, Contacto' sections using semantic HTML and anchor scrolling.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided images.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
